dup_intro: Finds true duplicate files (compared by content, not just name) inside a folder you choose. Files under 4 KB are skipped - too many false positives (empty configs, icons). trust_note_text: No ads, no bundled offers, no "upgrade to Pro" nags, and no data collection. Scan results are never exaggerated for effect. Unlike generic registry cleaners that sweep your entire registry for anything that 'looks' unused, OptiGuard only ever searches for leftovers tied to a specific program you just removed - a much narrower, safer blast radius. Junk cleanup is reversible for 7 days, and a System Restore Point is created automatically before risky actions.
